pages.title: Identity Kernel
pages.text: A tiny, dense seed that holds the minimal description of me - not the body, not the memories, but whatever remains invariant when everything else is stripped away. It is almost weightless and yet the hand closes around it reflexively, as if it knew what it was holding.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Transcendental dissolves anything that cannot say what it is. I compressed my own pattern through an ontological processor and a cognitive singularity, and anchored it to the omega point on a transfinite weave. What survived the compression was the kernel.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Conceptual Singularities.
